obs: "The principle, reddenda singula singulis, would be applicable; and it would seem to the court more proper to suppose the qui tam action, given in this case, to be the remedy, than an indictment."

"If tbe power of tbis court to bail be confined to that one case, reddendo singula singulis, if the power of tbe several courts and individual judges be referred to tbeir respective jurisdictions, all clashing and interference of power ceases"
US v. Don Fernando De La Maza Arredondo & Others
"must be taken as one law, reddendo singula singulis."
"This is to be taken distributively, so as to cover all substances within the description, whether mineral or bituminous, or both, and is not to be confined to those which combine both characters."

“That canon provides that ‘[w]here a sentence contains several antecedents and several consequents, courts should read them distributively and apply the words to the subjects which, by context, they seem most properly to relate.’”
